exceptions.justification: picomatch ReDoS through single-branch repeated extglobs; no fixed version exists (4.0.7 is the latest release and is in the vulnerable range). picomatch 4.0.7 is installed only as build, test and lint tooling: npm ls picomatch --all shows it under vite 8.2.4 (apps/patient-web), vite 7.3.7 and fdir via vite-plugin-singlefile, and vitest 4.1.12 and tinyglobby 0.2.17 (tinyglobby also under typescript-eslint). It matches globs written in this repository's own configuration, never input from a user. Evidence, 17 November 2026, from origin/main 3d0ddfbf: npm run build:production and python scripts/prepare-production-workers.py completed; the 8 release zips (911 files) and the 9 compiled Workers with their source maps (27 files) contain none of picomatch's source strings (picomatch, POSIX_REGEX_SOURCE, REGEX_NON_SPECIAL_CHARS, 'Expected pattern to be a non-empty string'), which the same search finds in node_modules/picomatch/lib.
